gen-fs-expose-gf-radio-canada-big: Striking and compressed, Expose barely pauses between lines. Radio Canada Big takes over beneath it as a plain sans with one uniform stroke and a tall x-height, so the display swing has somewhere quiet to land.
gen-fs-expose-gf-readex-pro: Tight, sharp, and a little dramatic up top. Readex Pro supplies the lasting quality, a sans-serif whose stroke never wavers from word to word, with open terminals that give the packed Expose heading room to breathe.
gen-fs-expose-gf-roboto: Roboto handles the body with generous round letters and capitals sitting close to lowercase height. Expose is best at compressed, striking display lines, while Roboto does its best work as the contemporary sans-serif that keeps running text easy on the eye.
gen-fs-expose-gf-ruda: Ruda brings a sizable x-height and a wire-thin monoline stroke, a plain sans built for screens. And its stems match its hairlines because there are none, which makes the sharp, compressed Expose headings feel like the loud sibling.
gen-fs-expose-gf-saira: Expose arrives compressed, striking, and hard to ignore. Saira follows beneath as a sans whose rounded letters stretch toward the top line and whose s shapes stay see-through, giving the dense heading a lighter, more open partner.
gen-fs-expose-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Expose sets a refined, tightly packed tone up top. Over many lines, Schibsted Grotesk reads as a friendly sans-serif, its tall-bowled e and a and unclosed terminals keeping the text approachable rather than dense.
gen-fs-expose-gf-sen: Sharp, compressed display lettering leads the way. Sen starts where Expose stops: Expose is best at striking, tightly spaced headlines, while Sen does its best work as a plain sans with tall lowercase and a constant ink stripe.
gen-fs-expose-gf-sintony: Tightly packed lettering with almost no gap between lowercase and capitals defines Expose. And Sintony answers with a chunky, tall midzone as a sans that curves smoothly without clogging, so the two sit together comfortably.
gen-fs-expose-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans reads modern and orderly, with tall lowercase and no stroke variation at all. And Expose above it brings the opposite, a compressed refined heading, so the page moves from tight display to a sans with open, rounded sides.
gen-fs-expose-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condens: Clean is the first impression, with Expose pressing its refined, compressed letters close together. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed then carries on gently, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its constant-weight strokes making a longer passage glide along.
